status: frozen after V19R response commissioning and V19T temperature-fit commissioning passed and host storage/cpu capacity was inspected, but before constructing the production manifest, selecting throughput-pilot cells, executing another response cell, fitting another spectrum, aggregating any regional temperature, opening lensing data, or changing gravity physics
purpose: Freeze deterministic batching, resource bounds, checkpoint semantics and an outcome-blind throughput pilot before the 5082-cell response-and-temperature production run.

workload.task_order: cluster_order, obsid ascending, bin_id ascending, ccd_id ascending

throughput_pilot.purpose: measure concurrent wall time, peak storage and failure behavior before authorizing the full workload
throughput_pilot.quantile_index_rule: floor(q*(n-1)+0.5) after sorting by source_band_events, obsid, bin_id and ccd_id ascending

resource_model.commissioning_timing_source: operator-observed V19R wall clock; approximate because V19R report did not emit monotonic timing

complete_cell_requires: cell report with exact hashes and every V19R-equivalent audit passing
checkpoint_and_retention.atomic_completion_rule: write products under a temporary cell directory and rename only after every audit passes
checkpoint_and_retention.resume_rule: reuse a completed cell only when its task key, parent hashes, product sizes, product hashes and audit record all match; otherwise retain it as a failed artifact and recompute without overwriting
checkpoint_and_retention.failure_rule: record every failed attempt, continue the current pilot or batch, prohibit regional aggregation and full completion claims until every frozen task has a passing cell; no failed cell may be silently omitted
checkpoint_and_retention.retry_rule: at most one unchanged rerun for an execution failure; no region, event, response, grouping, absorption, redshift, abundance, optimizer or parameter bound may change
checkpoint_and_retention.retention_rule: retain all four calibrated response products and cell reports through map construction and robustness audits; keep transient CIAO pfiles and temporary detector maps out of the scientific archive
checkpoint_and_retention.git_rule: commit compact manifests, reports and derived maps; keep the approximately 34 GB response archive in the hashed production store rather than Git LFS unless a later archival protocol explicitly requires it
